specificationName: Activity Execution Recording and Metrics Feedback Loop

changesApplied.changeMade: Replaced non-existent MCP tool call 'metabob_post_activity_result' with direct HTTP POST to backend API endpoint /api/v1/learning-loop/executions
changesApplied.reason: The MCP tool was never registered in metabob-rpc-api MCP server, causing silent failures. Backend infrastructure was 100% ready (activity_execution table, insert_execution, update_metrics_after_execution). Only needed to fix the broken transport layer.

impactAnalysis.blastRadius: Single function change, no impact on other components
dependencies: Environment variable METABOB_RPC_API_URL (defaults to k8s service)

changesApplied.architecturalBoundary: OpenCode (client) → HTTP POST → metabob-rpc-api (server). Single write path: all metrics calculations happen server-side. Respects service boundaries: ML logic in rpc-api, not opencode.

componentsNotChanged.reason: Already correct - calls TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution() with correct data
Already correct - endpoint exists and fully functional
Already correct - database layer ready and functional
Already correct - metrics aggregation logic ready and functional

dataFlowTransformation.before: Activity.complete() → TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution() → callMCPTool('metabob_post_activity_result') → [FAILS - tool not found] → silent failure → metrics stay at 0
dataFlowTransformation.after: Activity.complete() → TemplateMetricsClient.reportExecution() → HTTP POST to /api/v1/learning-loop/executions → insert_execution() → update_metrics_after_execution() → metrics updated in database

required.purpose: Backend API base URL for execution recording

verificationChecklist: New record appears in activity_execution table

Execution recording log shows: 'metrics reporting successful'

successCriteria.primary: Activity executions are recorded to activity_execution table
secondary: Success rates calculated correctly from execution data
Thompson sampling parameters adapt based on outcomes
Learning system can recommend template improvements
No silent failures in execution recording

rollbackPlan.safety: Single file change makes rollback safe and straightforward
rollbackPlan.impact: No breaking changes to other components
